validation: Sentiment checked blind by a second model (Sonnet) on a sample of 218 stories (every low-confidence row plus 100 at random), with Claude Fable 5.2 ruling on every disagreement: the check agreed with the coding on 182 (83%, and 94 of the 100 random rows); after review 20 labels were changed, and 17 more copies of the same events were aligned with those rulings.
sources: The monitoring deck's 250 clippings (slides 18 to 260), plus 648 stories the deck missed from every page of Dainik Savera (including its district pages), The Savera Times (including its district editions) and the District Front Page file (Punjabi Tribune, Rozana Spokesman, Punjabi Jagran and Dainik Jagran district pages); 60 repeated copies (mostly Dainik Savera district pages printed twice in its PDF) are marked as duplicates. The other papers' main editions are covered by the deck only; all 14 papers arrived (files taken from the Downloads folder). Relevant = about AAP, the Punjab government or a state matter.
